title: Hosted API tokenflow inventory and stress plan (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working draft to capture a parallel inventory (spreadsheet-ready) of token flows across our hosted API, plus a small-battery stress test plan that maps directly to spreadsheet scenarios. Goal: surface the highest-leverage levers (cache, batching, model-routing, regional routing) that move apparent per-token COGS and margin for Hosted API customers under realistic traffic shapes.

Audience:
Internal: product-optimize, hosted-api PMs, serving-runtime, infra-costing, solutions engineering. Not customer-facing in current form.

Overview / Problem statement:
- We have many per-token unit-econ artifacts; this doc aims to be a compact, actionable spreadsheet inventory that connects: model family, region, request shape, cache-hit assumptions, quantization profile, and downstream margin impact.
- Primary question: under plausible cache + batching + routing improvements, how much headroom do we gain on effective cost-per-1k-tokens (and thus margin expansion) for small/medium/large customers?

How to use the spreadsheet (high level):
- Each row = model-region-workload slice. Columns are annotated below. Use the scenario tabs to run: baseline, cache+10%, batch+25%, quantize-low, fallback-to-smaller-model. The stress test plan will hit the slices and compare observed vs modeled COGS.

Suggested spreadsheet columns (copy/paste to a new sheet):
- SliceID (short): e.g., LLA-13B|us-west-2|chat-short
- ModelFamily: e.g., lla-13b, rw-70b, rwx-70b-8bit
- Region: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1
- InstanceProfile: e.g., a10g, h100-80gb, gaudi2
- AvgTokensPerRequest (mean)
- P95TokensPerRequest
- RequestsPerMin (traffic shape)
- CostPerGPUHour_est (amortized)
- GPUEfficiencyFactor (serving runtime efficiency 0.0-1.0)
- CostPerToken_raw = CostPerGPUHour_est / (TokensProducedPerHour_est)
- CacheHitRate_assumed (0-1)
- CacheEffectiveTokensSaved = AvgTokensPerRequest * CacheHitRate_assumed
- OverheadPerRequest_ms (network + rpc overhead)
- OverheadCostPerRequest_est = OverheadPerRequest_ms * OverheadCostFactor (simple scaling, see notes)
- EffectiveCostPerToken = (CostPerToken_raw * (1 - CacheHitRate_assumed)) + (OverheadCostPerRequest_est / AvgTokensPerRequest)
- PricePer1kTokens (current)
- GrossMarginPer1kTokens = PricePer1kTokens - EffectiveCostPerToken*1000
- MarginImpact_if_cache_improves_to_X (repeat columns for scenario delta)
- Notes (qualitative: perf risks, quantize suitability, correctness sensitivity)

Example rows (toy numbers for illustration only):
- SliceID: lla-13b|us-west-2|chat-short
  ModelFamily: lla-13b
  Region: us-west-2
  InstanceProfile: a10g
  AvgTokensPerRequest: 120
  P95TokensPerRequest: 600
  RequestsPerMin: 1800
  CostPerGPUHour_est: $2.50
  GPUEfficiencyFactor: 0.78
  (implied) CostPerToken_raw: $0.0000095
  CacheHitRate_assumed: 0.22
  EffectiveCostPerToken: $0.0000085
  PricePer1kTokens: $0.40
  GrossMarginPer1kTokens: $0.31
  Notes: chat-short typically has high repetition; moderate cache lift likely.

- SliceID: rw-70b|eu-west-1|long-gen
  ModelFamily: rw-70b
  Region: eu-west-1
  InstanceProfile: h100-80gb
  AvgTokensPerRequest: 950
  P95TokensPerRequest: 3500
  RequestsPerMin: 120
  CostPerGPUHour_est: $14.00
  GPUEfficiencyFactor: 0.89
  (implied) CostPerToken_raw: $0.000021
  CacheHitRate_assumed: 0.04
  EffectiveCostPerToken: $0.0000195
  PricePer1kTokens: $3.20
  GrossMarginPer1kTokens: $1.26
  Notes: high variability on long-gen; fallback-to-quantized 70B variant may be viable for low-confidence outputs.

Assumptions & calculation notes (keep simple in sheet):
- TokensProducedPerHour_est = GPUThroughputTokensPerSecond * 3600 * GPUEfficiencyFactor. Use measured throughput from perf lab.
- Overhead cost attribution: map network+rpc latency to a per-request CPU/RAM marginal cost bucket (placeholder: $0.0002 per 100ms of overhead); we will validate in stress test.
- Cache modeling: assume cache applies a token-level prefix cache (not request-level). Cache hit rate applied to token counts, not to request counts.
- Quantization/packing: we model two classes: int8-quantized (saves ~25-40% GPU cost on some kernels) and aggressive 4-bit (saves more but may drop perf). Specific multipliers per-model are in perf-inventory tab (link to perf lab results).

Prioritized experiments (3-week sprint):
1) Cache-boost experiment (owner: Liam Chen)
   - Hypothesis: increasing cache coverage on chat-short slice by +15ppt reduces effective cost-per-1k by ~10–12% and increases margin accordingly.
   - Spreadsheet target: set CacheHitRate from 22% -> 37% for lla-13b|us-west-2|chat-short scenario and compare.
   - Run: deploy cache TTL tweaks + prefix-key improvements, measure hit rate and latency delta for 7 days.

2) Batch sizing re-tune (owner: Priya Natarajan)
   - Hypothesis: runtime batch tuning for us-west-2 medium traffic increases GPUEfficiencyFactor from 0.78 -> 0.86 for short-chat traffic (improve shared context packing).
   - Spreadsheet target: recompute CostPerToken_raw with new GPUEfficiencyFactor.
   - Run: A/B test on a subset of traffic (10% of production) for 3 days.

3) Fallback routing to quantized model (owner: Ethan Park)
   - Hypothesis: for low-confidence outputs (model score < X), route to int8-quantized variant to save ~30% per-token cost with minimal user-visible regression in 95% of cases.
   - Spreadsheet target: create combined row with weighted cost across confidence split.

Stress test plan (mapping to spreadsheet scenarios):
- Duration: 48-hour run per scenario, synthetic traffic generator + small fraction of real workload to validate no regression.
- Scenarios: baseline, cache +10ppt, batch +10% efficiency, combined. Also regional failover: shift 30% of eu-west-1 traffic to us-west-2 to measure delta in effective cost + latency.
- Measurements to capture: observed CacheHitRate, avg tokens, P95 latency, GPU utilization, observed CostPerGPUHour (billing proxy), request drop/error rates.
- Acceptance criteria: modeled EffectiveCostPerToken within ±12% of observed (otherwise revise modeling multipliers).

Risks & edge cases:
- Cache correctness: increased cache hit rate may increase stale semantics for stateful chat; limit to idempotent/assist flows only.
- Re-routing/regional shifts: network egress and inter-region costs may offset GPU savings; include egress line item in spreadsheet if cross-region routing is tested.
- Quantization quality: some prompt classes degrade non-linearly; create minimal eval set per-customer segment before routing.

Deliverables from sprint:
- Spreadsheet with scenario tabs: baseline, cache, batch, quantize, combined, regional-failover.
- Stress test logs and summary: CSVs for each slice showing modeled vs observed metrics.
- One-pager recommendation with prioritized actions and estimated quarterly margin uplift.

Next steps (owners & timeline):
- Week 0: copy this template to product/optimize spreadsheet and populate with measured throughput numbers from perf lab (owner: Liam)
- Week 1: run cache-boost experiment and update spreadsheet with actual hit rates (owner: Liam)
- Week 2: batch re-tune A/B and add observed efficiency numbers (owner: Priya)
- Week 3: quantized fallback pilot on low-risk tenant and update model (owner: Ethan)
- Week 4: deck for exec summarizing margin lift and recommended rollouts (owner: Ava)

Notes to self / unresolved questions:
- Need a standardized conversion from measured GPU utilization -> amortized CostPerGPUHour that accounts for reserved vs burst capacity. Who owns the reserved capacity allocation model? (cc SRE finance)
- Should we include customer-segmenting by price tier in the spreadsheet? (likely yes; add 2 extra columns: TierMultiplier, ContractedPriceOverride)
- Where to store eval prompts for quantized fallback? Recommend: Confluence eval-set repo with clear naming: "quantize-evals/hosted-api".

Appendix: quick sensitivity kernel (copy into small sheet):
- Baseline effective cost per token (E0) = 0.000020
- Scenario A (cache +15ppt) -> E1 = E0 * (1 - ((0.15 * baseline_tokens_fraction))) [illustrative]
- Scenario B (batch +10% eff) -> E2 = E0 * 0.90
- Combined impact approx multiplicative: Ecombined = E0 * 0.90 * (1 - cache_delta_effect)
